text:
jamie: Idea 6: add a tiny \"Choose your path\" pill group under the pricing calculator results: Demo | Webinar | Self-serve. One click sets CTA and emits an event so we can route leads. Low overhead UX.

kiran: Good. Make pill prominence dynamic: if estimate > $2000 show Demo first.

sofia: Copy variants to test: \"Book a demo\" vs \"Talk to sales\"; \"Join webinar\" vs \"See walkthrough\". Small wording changes only.

ryan: Analytics payload example:
```
window.dataLayer.push({
 event: 'pricing_path_select',
 path: 'demo|webinar|self',
 calc_estimate_usd: 2200,
 exp_id: 'exp_98123',
 session_id: 'sess_xxx'
});
```
Include utm and session for joins.

priyanka: Sales ops: prefer SDR routing floor at $1500/mo ARR. Add is_enterprise_candidate boolean and lead_score: 'enterprise|mid|small'. Webhook expects {email, calc_estimate_usd, path, preferred_cta_label}.

jamie: We'll run a 14-day A/B: control (no pills) vs variant (pills). Primary metric = demo bookings/visitor. Secondary = webinar signups.

sofia: UX: add a one-line FAQ toggle visible when Demo selected: \"Reserved capacity includes SLA & priority support\". Keep full FAQ link for self-serve.

kiran: Accessibility: pills keyboard-focusable and ARIA-selected. Add debounce so toggles don't spam events; only send on final CTA or first selection per session.

analytics-bot: Experiment created: pricing_path_pills_v1 exp_98123. Client-side assignment enabled.

ryan: Tracking checklist: pricing_path_select, click_to_cta, cta_conversion, webinar_attend. Add variant_id and experiment metadata to every event.

priyanka: Sales heads notified: /cc @sales-team. Expect webhook changes.

jamie: Timeline: mock today, spec + tracking Wed, dev Thurs, staging QA Fri, 10% rollout next Mon. I'll draft dashboard and KPI sheet.

sofia: Mock ready by EOD. Adding small micro-survey after CTA (one question) as optional test.

jamie: Great. Keep pill labels internal to the experiment (no site-wide renames). We'll test tiny tier-name sets only in the pill text.
